thesis: VTRS has rallied about 10% since the Nov 5 earnings print with no explanatory headline, and it sits near its 52-week high in a confirmed risk-off tape (QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX at the 0.905 one-year percentile, 10-year yield at 5.115). The stock has pulled back three sessions, and the pre-market indication of 20.33 points lower. The balance sheet is levered (13.58B debt against 2.0B cash), GAAP margin is negative and revenue is flat, so the 'cheap' forward P/E rests on adjusted earnings. Price is already within about 5% of the 21.5 mean analyst target, and reward/risk of 1.33 is thin for a long entered into a falling market. An 8-K Item 2.01 filed yesterday has unread terms, so sizing blind is unjustified.
